request.style: English, female soul voice, solo with subtle choir, upright bass, piano, Hammond organ, slow blues, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Caleb son of Hezron
Had children by his wife
Azubah gave birth
To Jesher and Shobab
Ardon stood with them
In the line of Judah

[Chorus]
Azubah's sons are named
In the genealogy
Jesher Shobab Ardon
From her womb they came

[Verse]
When Azubah died
Caleb took Ephrath
She bore him Hur
A new branch grew
From her life to death
The record remains

[Chorus]
Azubah's sons are named
In the genealogy
Jesher Shobab Ardon
From her womb they came

[Bridge]
From Hezron's grandson
To the tribe of Judah
A woman in the list
Connecting the lines

[Outro]
Azubah's sons are named
Jesher Shobab Ardon
